added: A contra figure's dancers can now be the previous or next neighbors' role1s or role2s, such as "prev larks" and "next robins", worded with your dialect's role terms. Each is listed straight after its neighbors. An older version of the app does not know them: it marks a figure that holds one as invalid, and opening that figure there replaces the value with the default.

ParamVocab.pairDancerSets gains prevRole1s, prevRole2s, nextRole1s and nextRole2s, each straight after prevNeighbors or nextNeighbors, joining the unreleased taxonomy v40. They read through squareRoleSelectorWords, so they take the dialect's role words, and seriesDancerWords reads them back, plural only, from a figure's displayed text ("next larks swing"). They have no pair inverse or opposite. chain.who takes them too, and chainHandForWho gives each its role's hand.
fixed: A figure's plural subject (such as a hey's first pass) and a wording condition on a dancer param show a role selector in the dialect's role words ("head larks") instead of the canonical token.
